title: SDK quickstart bugbash checkpoint — onboarding friction & CI flakes
body:
Checkpoint notes from the DevExp quickstart bug bash (informal)

Date: 2026-09-01
Facilitator: Priya Raman
Attendees: Priya, Evan, Marco, Sofia, Jamal, + a few async contributors in Slack (#devexp-quickstarts)

Agenda:
- Rapid triage of failures found in the quickstart smoke tests (TS + Python)
- Reproduce top 5 flakes and assign owners
- Discuss telemetry events to add for onboarding funnel
- Decide patch plan for SDK release candidate and docs updates

High-level summary:
- Ran a focused bug bash across the quickstart flows (playground-scratch sample, CLI-init, typescript and python snippets). Found 18 unique issues: 8 high-impact (blocks new devs), 6 medium, 4 low. Most common: auth redirect behavior in the sample app, mismatch between README snippets and current SDK method signatures, and CI matrix flakes on Node 18 vs Node 20.

Notable reproductions / findings:
1) playground-scratch auth redirect (high)
   - Symptom: after completing OAuth flow locally, sample app sometimes lands on a blank page with no client created.
   - Repro steps (intermittent): run sample with npm start, hit /auth, complete provider redirect; observe session token not written to localStorage.
   - Root cause (suspected): our local dev token refresh handler (client.rotateToken()) is racing with startup bootstrap code that writes initial creds. Race only appears when using the development proxy (dev-auth-proxy v0.7.1).

2) README snippets out-of-sync (high)
   - TS quickstart shows createClient({ apiKey }) but SDK now prefers createClient({ auth: { apiKey } }). New devs copy-paste and get TypeError.
   - Action: update README and generate snippet tests to fail CI when mismatch detected.

3) CI flaky e2e on macOS / Node 18 (medium)
   - Several runs failed in GH Actions matrix with timeout during the sample app build step; appears on node:18 only. Node 20 is stable.
   - Short-term: pin matrix to Node 20 for the quickstart workflow.

4) Ephemeral credential rotation (medium)
   - Integration tests for private deployment path occasionally report 401 from the staging control plane. Logs show rotation events during long-lived test runs.
   - Conversation with infra required — staging dedicated capacity currently recycles certs every 12 hours.

Telemetry / onboarding metrics:
- Quick glance at onboarding telemetry (from internal dashboard): 42% drop-off at the "create client" step, 18% at the "run sample app" step. This aligns with the README mismatch and the playground auth race.
- Proposal: add two short-lived telemetry events in the quickstart flow: quickstart.client_initialized and quickstart.sample_started. Keep payload minimal (boolean success, SDK version). No PII.

Decisions taken in this session:
- Revert the breaking param change in SDK v0.9.2 for the createClient convenience overloads; ship a minor patch 0.9.3 that restores the old signature and logs a deprecation warning. (Owner: Evan, ETA: 2026-09-03)
- Add a generated-snippet smoke test to the quickstart CI: run a tiny harness to insert snippets into a temp project and ensure compile/publish step succeeds. (Owner: Marco, ETA: 2026-09-06)
- Pin quickstart CI to Node 20 for now while we investigate the GH Actions runner image discrepancy. (Owner: Sofia, ETA: 2026-09-02)
- Add telemetry events quickstart.client_initialized and quickstart.sample_started to the TS + Python quickstarts; send to analytics-prod with a sampling rate of 1%. (Owner: Priya, ETA: 2026-09-07)

Open questions / unresolved:
- Do we want to continue allowing both createClient({ apiKey }) and createClient({ auth: { apiKey } })? If yes, for how long? (We agreed to keep both but warn.)
- Should the snippet validation test run on all PRs or only on docs/quickstart changes? Running on every PR adds time. Suggest: run on PRs that touch SDK, docs, or samples.
- Staging infra: can SRE reduce cert rotation window for dedicated staging? This will reduce ephemeral 401 flakes during long tests. (Assigned: Jamal to open ticket with SRE)

Action items:
- Evan: prepare SDK 0.9.3 PR that restores old signature + deprecation log. Include changelog entry and clear migration note. Due 2026-09-03. Linked: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/842
- Marco: implement generated-snippet smoke test harness in repo devexp/qa-scripts. Add workflow job (non-blocking for merge) and report results in PR. Due 2026-09-06.
- Sofia: pin quickstart CI workflows to node:20 and watch two subsequent runs for stability. Revert pin once we have a fix. Due 2026-09-02.
- Priya: add the two telemetry events to the TS and Python quickstarts, coordinate with analytics to verify ingestion, and prepare a short dashboard to track drop-off. Due 2026-09-07.
- Jamal: open an infra ticket for staging cert rotation and request a temporary extension for dedicated capacity used by quickstart tests. Due 2026-09-02.
- All: quick manual walkthrough (10–15 min) scheduled for 2026-09-03 11:00 PT to confirm 0.9.3 prerelease and CI pin.

Notes to self (informal):
- Add a short checklist to the quickstart repo for maintainers: update snippet, run local sample, confirm telemetry events. Keep checklist in .github/CONTRIBUTING.md as a quick section.
- Consider a "safe mode" flag for the playground-scratch that disables background rotation to make it stable for local demos. Could be a simple env var (DEV_ROTATION=false). Prototype in sample-app.

Next checkpoint:
- Async updates in #devexp-quickstarts Slack channel.
- Quick follow-up huddle 2026-09-03 11:00 PT (15 minutes).

Raw findings and logs (copied here for context and future triage):
- GH Action run 1732: build timeout node:18 — https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/actions/runs/1732
- Sample app console snippet (auth race): "Error: no-client-found" at startup logger
- Telemetry snapshot: onboarding funnel (Aug 28–Sep 1): impressions: 2,412; completed-run: 1,183; drop at create-client: 1,013

References / links to check during follow-up:
- Quickstart repo: https://github.com/redwood-inference/quickstarts
- Playground sample: https://github.com/redwood-inference/quickstarts/tree/main/playground-scratch
- SDK PR (revert/patch): https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/842

If you have immediate bandwidth, take the playground-scratch repro steps locally and paste console output into this doc (below) — helps narrow the race condition.

-- Priya
